## How to Add Photos

To add a new photo:

1. Place the image file in the `images/` folder
2. Add it to this page using:

```markdown
![Alt text](images/your-image.jpg){description="Caption text"}
```

For a gallery layout, wrap multiple images in:

```markdown
::: {layout-ncol=3}
![](images/img1.jpg)
![](images/img2.jpg)  
![](images/img3.jpg)
:::
```
